page_title: AST 4-0 BOU | Aston Villa v Bournemouth 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Bournemouth hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' He should have scored! David Brooks (Bournemouth) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Evann Guessand (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch for Morgan Rogers.
82' 4 - 0 The attempt by Youri Tielemans is blocked, but from the middle of the box Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) hits the rebound into the bottom left corner. He alters the score to 4:0.
81' The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
81' It is time for a substitution. Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) is on for Ollie Watkins.
81' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) replacing Boubacar Kamara.
77' Here comes a substitution. Evanilson is given a rest as he is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
77' 3 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 3:0.
76' Aston Villa earn a corner.
75' The shots on goal statistics – 6:4.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) replaces Amadou Onana.
71' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. John McGinn will be replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
71' The substitution has been made. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) has replaced Emiliano Buendia.
70' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
67' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

67' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Emiliano Martinez to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
66' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is going to take the penalty!

66' The players claim that Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Bournemouth!
65' The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
64' John McGinn (Aston Villa) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, makes a stunning save.
64' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Substitution. Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) has come on for Alex Scott.
63' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) replaces Justin Kluivert.
63' Substitution. Adrien Truffert makes way for Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
59' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
59' CHANCE! Evanilson (Bournemouth) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the left post!
58' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.
57' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
56' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Emiliano Martinez makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
55' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
54' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
53' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
53' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
52' The Bournemouth players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
49' John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul after Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) hacks down one of his opponents.
47' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is hurriedly cleared.
47' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Substitution. Alejandro Jimenez walks off the pitch and Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
45+6' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tackles a bit over-zealously and John Brooks blows for a foul.
45+4' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
45+3' It looks like Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. John Brooks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45+1' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Evanilson (Bournemouth) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and blazes his shot high over the crossbar!
43' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) brings his opponent down with a tackle and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
40' 2 - 0 Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
38' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
37' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
36' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

35' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
35' Evanilson (Bournemouth) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
32' John Brooks blows his whistle after Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
31' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
31' The ball possession is 60:40.
28' 1 - 0 Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) scores from a free kick after smashing the ball over the defensive wall and into the top left corner of the goal!
27' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
25' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
21' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
18' The referee blows his whistle as Evanilson (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
17' John Brooks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alex Scott (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down.
15' A cross from a corner kick by Bournemouth is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
14' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.
13' What was Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
13' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

12' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Djordje Petrovic was alert and the score remains the same.
10' It looks like Adam Smith (Bournemouth) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Andoni Iraola replaces him with Alejandro Jimenez.
9' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.
9' Some patient build-up play from Aston Villa as they look to unlock the defence.
8' The injury to Adam Smith (Bournemouth) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
4' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
2' John McGinn (Aston Villa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Aston Villa will kick-off.
John Brooks will referee today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
